per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to routine actions (e.g., searching for a student or updating an assignment) within a couple of seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be intuitive and easy to use, requiring minimal training for non-technical users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available during business hours with a target uptime of 95%.
The system should support concurrent use by around ten users during peak times, particularly in the mornings.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement role-based access control to restrict sensitive information to authorized users only.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should prevent obvious mistakes, such as entering shifts outside normal clinical hours or assigning students to inappropriate sites.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear warnings or suggestions for borderline mistakes, nudging users away from potential errors.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should notify users of schedule changes via email, in-app reminders, and text messages for urgent last-minute changes.
The system should automatically save changes and provide a way to roll back to previous versions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'
